---
title: "View Simulation Results"
---

```{r, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggpubr)
library(egg)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggridges)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

source("Functions.R")
source("PlotResults.R")
```

**Purpose:** View raw simulation results of fixed habitat/equilibrium simulation runs. 

## Setup

Load each result .rds object and bind directly into a list. Using a helper function ensures each `res` object is freed from memory as soon as the objects needed for plotting (`ibm_summary`, `spawn_log`, `fish_registry`, `habitat_df`) are extracted. The large `ibm_long` is deliberately not kept.
```{r}
#| cache: false

# Extract params from one file (small object)
res            <- readRDS("results/Baseline_ColdOnly_005percold_rep01.rds")
sim_params     <- res$params
habitat_df     <- res$habitat_df
exp_start_date <- sim_params$mindate + years(sim_params$nyears_burnin)
rm(res)

# Helper: read one scenario, keep only the objects needed by plot_population(),
# and free res (including the large ibm_long) before returning
load_scen <- function(path, pc, ht, pcmax_cold, pcmax_warm) {
  res <- readRDS(path)
  list(
    ibm_summary   = res$ibm_summary,
    spawn_log     = res$spawn_log,
    fish_registry = res$fish_registry,
    habitat_df    = res$habitat_df,
    pc = pc, ht = ht, pcmax_cold = pcmax_cold, pcmax_warm = pcmax_warm
  )
}

ibm_list_mech <- list(
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdOnly_100percold_rep01.rds",        1.00, "Cold only",            0.5, NA_real_),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdOnly_095percold_rep01.rds",        0.95, "Cold only",            0.5, NA_real_),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdOnly_075percold_rep01.rds",        0.75, "Cold only",            0.5, NA_real_),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdOnly_050percold_rep01.rds",        0.50, "Cold only",            0.5, NA_real_),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdOnly_025percold_rep01.rds",        0.25, "Cold only",            0.5, NA_real_),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdOnly_010percold_rep01.rds",        0.10, "Cold only",            0.5, NA_real_),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdOnly_005percold_rep01.rds",        0.05, "Cold only",            0.5, NA_real_),

  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarm_095percold_rep01.rds",        0.95, "Cold + Warm",          0.5, 0.5),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarm_075percold_rep01.rds",        0.75, "Cold + Warm",          0.5, 0.5),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarm_050percold_rep01.rds",        0.50, "Cold + Warm",          0.5, 0.5),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarm_025percold_rep01.rds",        0.25, "Cold + Warm",          0.5, 0.5),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarm_010percold_rep01.rds",        0.10, "Cold + Warm",          0.5, 0.5),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarm_005percold_rep01.rds",        0.05, "Cold + Warm",          0.5, 0.5),
  
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarmHighP_095percold_rep01.rds",   0.95, "Cold + Warm (high P)", 0.5, 0.6),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarmHighP_075percold_rep01.rds",   0.75, "Cold + Warm (high P)", 0.5, 0.6),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarmHighP_050percold_rep01.rds",   0.50, "Cold + Warm (high P)", 0.5, 0.6),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarmHighP_025percold_rep01.rds",   0.25, "Cold + Warm (high P)", 0.5, 0.6),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarmHighP_010percold_rep01.rds",   0.10, "Cold + Warm (high P)", 0.5, 0.6),
  load_scen("results/Baseline_ColdWarmHighP_005percold_rep01.rds",   0.05, "Cold + Warm (high P)", 0.5, 0.6)
)
```


## Null: cold only

### 100% cold

Annual abundance/biomass, age structure, weight-at-age, density-growth, apparent survival, compensatory dynamics, and reproduction.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
plot_population(
  ibm_summary    = ibm_list_mech[[1]]$ibm_summary,
  spawn_log      = ibm_list_mech[[1]]$spawn_log,
  fish_registry  = ibm_list_mech[[1]]$fish_registry,
  habitat_df     = ibm_list_mech[[1]]$habitat_df,
  exp_start_date = exp_start_date
)
```
